name: Ellmarch Frame 16 Original
description: This listing is an austenitic-hold annealing oven listed with peak temperature 1362 degrees Celsius, chamber capacity 1904 litres, heat up 68 minutes. Its remaining stated figures are cycles before relining 117 cycles, unit price set after acceptance, heat source induction. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
